title: "Mission 1316, 1 November 1956" – U-2 flight route over Egypt, Israel and Suez
description: Map titled "Mission 1316, 1 November 1956" showing a U-2 flight path with directional arrows from Incirlik Airbase at Adana, Turkey, south past Cyprus (Nicosia, Akrotiri) to Egypt. The route makes repeated east-west passes over the Suez Canal and Sinai Peninsula, loops around Cairo and Almaza Airbase, and runs along Israel and Jordan before returning north. Marked "Secret NOFORN" with handwritten page number "118."
